question: Can the exact FRBSF Daily News Sentiment Index establish attributable original public availability, source/method chronology and revision-aware 2023-2025 coverage before any market join?

known_before_declaration.current_official_page: Daily observation labels, weekly updates, declining trailing weights and newspaper-composition adjustment. Current page names 24 newspapers through Factiva and advertises current CSV/XLSX and replication links; those payloads have not been acquired.
known_before_declaration.launch_and_method_docs: April 2020 launch/Letter and March 2020 working-paper sections were read as method documentation. They describe an earlier 16-newspaper LexisNexis corpus; the Letter gives 5% daily decay. The working paper's monthly index estimates newspaper/type and time effects and normalizes plotted series. These descriptions do not establish the later live producer, a transition date or a 2023-2025 release archive.
known_before_declaration.exposure_boundary: Primary method pages include pre-2021 historical illustrations and academic economic applications, not candidate evidence. Current publication metadata includes 2026 dates, but no 2026 source-value array, 2023-2025 index table, market response or strategy outcome was acquired. No claim of epistemic blindness to earlier V7/V8 aggregates exists.
known_before_declaration.method_limit: A full-sample illustrative monthly estimator is not automatically the live daily estimator. A difference in provider descriptions is not proof of when or how historical values changed. Both need exact evidence.

fixed_scope.calendar_meaning: All target calendar dates, including weekends and missing releases, remain part of the coverage question. 1096 is the requested calendar, not observed or certified source coverage.
fixed_scope.historical_release_metadata_window: 2023-01-01 through 2026-01-12 inclusive, solely to describe release/vintage timing for the declared observation dates. No 2026 numeric observation is permitted.
fixed_scope.historical_method_context: Official 2020 launch/working-paper/Letter plus dated exact-series method or revision notices and metadata necessary to identify any transition affecting 2023-2025. Current explanatory metadata may be read without current index arrays.
fixed_scope.source_identity: Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco Daily News Sentiment Index, including publisher-documented exact predecessor URLs for this same series. A different sentiment, uncertainty or survey series is excluded.
allowable_metadata_fields: observation period, advertised cadence, dated release or revision notice
vintage/realtime date, archive capture date and original URL
provider/newspaper sample, article inclusion/scoring method, composition coefficients
causal versus centered smoothing, normalization/fit window, revision/finalization policy
advertised archive/file links and exact-series catalog identity
conditionally_allowable_numeric_fields: same-date sentiment value from an authenticated, date-restricted historical vintage
publisher release or independently preserved archive timestamp, vintage identity and revision marker
fixed_scope.numeric_acquisition_gate: Only after a recorded source-authority decision identifies an authentic historical-vintage route that excludes 2026 observations before response decoding. Preserve all retrieved values and missing dates; do not select by sign, variation or later asset response. An archive capture proves availability no later than capture, not the precise original release time. No current mixed-history workbook/CSV or uninspected replication ZIP is downloaded. If the route does not qualify, acquire no numeric values.
fixed_scope.missing_boundary_behavior: An original release not found, a holiday-delayed issue, uncertain publication timestamp or censored last-week observation remains explicitly unresolved. Do not assume a Monday release or attach a fixed day/week lag to current revised values.

fixed_evidence_questions: What is the exact daily observation label and public update cadence? Is there dated evidence of actual releases and delays for the requested history?
Does an official exact-series vintage/realtime catalog or an attributable archive of original publisher files exist for the requested history? Distinguish archive capture from original release.
When did the publisher's named corpus/provider/sample change, and did that transition revise earlier observations? Do the original releases themselves preserve the historical method?

Are composition coefficients and normalization estimated only on information available at each publication, or revised retrospectively? What article ingestion/backfill and finalization rules are documented?
Does the daily smoother use only past article information? Does a trailing smoother nevertheless aggregate retrospectively changed scores/coefficients?
Can all 1096 requested dates be classified as authentically available, absent or unresolved, without market data or an invented availability lag?

search_families: Exact-series FRBSF historical vintages, real-time releases and revision notices
Exact-series FRBSF LexisNexis-to-Factiva, sample and methodology changes
Exact-series FRED/ALFRED catalog and vintage metadata, not similarly named surveys
Original publisher data URL and archived-capture index metadata for the declared release window
bounded_discovery.limits: At most 12 targeted documentation/catalog searches, at most 12 directly relevant primary follow-up documents and at most 6 exact-URL archive-index metadata requests. These bound this source question, not engineering-fault retries or the full continuing Goal. Resolve attributable retrieval/parser faults without an arbitrary retry cap; keep all original fault evidence.
bounded_discovery.archive_rule: An archive/catalog is only a preservation/discovery route to the original publisher, not a replacement series. Read timestamp/original-URL/digest/status metadata before any saved-file request. Inaccessible or undiscovered archives do not prove global absence.
bounded_discovery.no_external_side_effects: No credentials, paid subscriptions, Factiva article acquisition, messages to publisher/authors, new automation or remote writes. Public read-only research only.

decision_contract.feasible: Exact source identity and complete declared point-in-time history are attributable either through authentic historical release/vintage contents or through sufficiently specific publisher-certified nonrevision/finalization plus actual publication evidence. A model that was refit at each release may be causally usable if that exact released vintage is preserved; do not impose needless permanent-coefficient immutability. All remaining availability/normalization/capture precision restrictions must be explicit. This is source readiness only, not alpha, trade density or native eligibility.
decision_contract.partial_unready: Source identity and method/cadence may be established while historical availability, revision chronology or complete dated coverage remains unresolved. Close the exact study with an explicit gap matrix, null monetary verdict and no candidate. A finite search non-discovery is not universal absence.
decision_contract.fault: Network, source-format, parsing or invocation failures remain attributable correction states, never negative economic evidence. If external archive access remains unavailable, state that precise access limitation and complete the other independent documentation questions.
decision_contract.after_close: Freeze the whole source unit and recompare all Programs 1-5 and 7 before any genuinely independent candidate or materially distinct successor. Program 6 remains outside the Goal.

closed_neighborhood_protection.rule: No alternate-news substitution into the closed EPU/realized-volatility ratio, five-week state, cash-session LONG or related lag/window/threshold/normalization/holding/risk rescue. No old code, feature, event, label, model, price/response table or economic output is imported. The selected positive/negative news-tone publication question has no declared strategy direction or mechanism.
closed_neighborhood_protection.family_015: The complete ordered-context and IID bundle remains immutable. No calibration, depth, alphabet, magnitude, cushion, timeframe, exit or capital rescue.

storage_and_runtime.growth_scope: All own source text, metadata, evidence and any qualified date-restricted numeric slice combined. Check before each acquisition; no cleanup is required.
storage_and_runtime.runtime: No native terminal, EA, strategy adapter, model, broker API or old reader restart. No test-only CLI, validator, checker, CI or project Skill. Ordinary one-shot documentation/metadata retrieval and evidence production only.

live_boundary: V7R remains the frozen entries-disabled release. Completed read-only readiness heartbeat stays PAUSED; the user directly performs final trading activation. No Live files, settings, risk, authority or operating process changes.
full_goal: Continue the independent Python-adapter/ONNX-plus-EA V8 Challenge until pause or complete valid native winner. This source question does not replace, complete or block the full Goal.
